description: Traffic Volumes for is a series of datasets listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. The traffic volume flow map illustrates the Average Annual Weekday Traffic (AAWT), the average number of vehicles in 24 hours adjusted for seasonal variation to represent the average weekday. The numbers on the map are two-way totals. Additional information can be found at: More information about Calgary's Traffic Counts system is available at:. Coverage: Calgary. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the category Transportation/Transit. Its tags are roads, traffic, volumes, segments. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: The City of Calgary. The portal shows 2020-06-12 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
